name: SearchField
description: A text field for searching, with a search icon and a clear button that a tree cannot remove.

label.description: The field's name, drawn above it.

isLabelHidden.description: Hides the label from sight; it still names the field for a screen reader.

errorMessage.description: Set means invalid: the field shows this message under it.

name.description: Names the value inside a Form block.

variant.description: secondary is for a field on a grey surface.

fullWidth.description: false takes the natural field width token.

defaultValue.description: Starts at this value; the merchant changes it.

value.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree. Pair it with isReadOnly: rewriting a field on every keystroke fights a Persian keyboard.

searchIcon.description: The search icon at the start.

clearButton.description: The clear button, shown while there is text.
